The '''''Journal of Geometry''''' is a triannual [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] covering [[geometry]], broadly considered. In particular this includes "foundations of geometry, geometric algebra, finite geometries, combinatorial geometry, and special geometries".{{r|br}} It was established in 1971 by [[Walter Benz]]{{r|50y}} and is published by [[Birkhäuser]].{{r|br}} The [[editors-in-chief]] are Hans Havlicek ([[Technische Universität Wien]]) and Alexander Kreuzer ([[Universität Hamburg]]).{{r|eds}}

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in [[EBSCO Information Services|EBSCO databases]],{{r|miar}} [[Emerging Sources Citation Index]],{{r|isi}} [[Scopus]],{{r|scopus}} and [[zbMATH Open]].{{r|zbl}}
